validate_padding_strategy: validate a padding strategy value against allowed names like longest, max_length, do_not_pad
validate_truncation_strategy: validate a truncation strategy value against allowed names like only_first, only_second, longest_first, do_not_truncate
validate_device_string: validate a device string or integer to ensure it matches supported names like cpu, cuda, mps, xla, xpu, meta
validate_tensor_shape: validate that a tensor or list of tensors matches an expected shape with optional string dimension aliases
validate_interval_value: create a parameterized validator that ensures a numeric value falls within a defined min-max interval
